observe: Verify claims, prices, identity, source dates and actual scope; unknown facts remain unknown.
Inspect hero, proof, choice and action at reading scale and page overview; record hierarchy, crop and typography defects.
Verify actual originals, rights, derivatives, crop and fallback; do not substitute generated proof.
Complete the primary navigation/selection path in an authorized test context and observe its real outcome.
Inspect actual rendered narrow and wide compositions, long copy, overlap and important controls; identify emulation limits.
Use keyboard through the main path; observe focus, order, controls and no focus trap or obstruction.
Observe usable information and actions during relevant loading, failed media and failed API states.
Measure relevant load or interaction workload under a recorded build/device/network/cache scenario; do not substitute a code review.
Observe reversal, interruption, rapid re-entry, direct anchor/reload and relevant teardown/history behavior.
Observe readable stable content and usable actions with preference enabled and changed during motion.
Change representative content in an authorized test path; exercise long text, reorder, missing media and unpublished data.
Observe invalid, pending, server-error and actual confirmation states without unauthorized external messages.
Use provider-authorized test flow; verify actual variant, amount, error and no duplicate submission.
Verify real model/selection mapping, loading/failure fallback and usable controls without the renderer.
Run the applicable build and risk-targeted checks; identify mocked and real dependencies separately.
Verify editable sources, actual status, relevant asset credits, content ownership and release/rollback route.
